title: Audit event
description: A single Punar audit-trail event as emitted by local services (spec section 53). Machine-emitted JSON runtime record, so field names are snake_case. Sensitive-content rule (spec section 53): audit events must never contain passwords, secret values, tokens, private keys, prompt contents by default, or source code — only identifiers, decisions, and outcomes are recorded.

event_id.title: Event id
event_id.description: Unique audit event identifier with 'evt_' prefix, e.g. 'evt_123' (spec section 53).

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: RFC 3339 time at which the event occurred (spec section 53; the spec example elides the value as "...").

device_id.title: Device id
device_id.description: Device on which the event occurred, 'dev_' prefix, e.g. 'dev_123' (spec sections 38, 53).

user_id.title: User id
user_id.description: Human user in whose session the event occurred, e.g. 'alice@acme.com' (spec section 53). The spec shows an email address but does not mandate the form; any non-empty identifier is accepted.

agent_session_id.title: Agent session id
agent_session_id.description: AI agent session the event is attributed to, 'agt_' prefix, e.g. 'agt_123' (spec sections 19.2, 53).

project_id.title: Project id
project_id.description: Project workspace the event occurred in, e.g. 'atlas' (spec sections 14, 53).

source.title: Source
source.description: Kind of principal that originated the event, e.g. 'ai_agent' (spec sections 18, 53).

action.title: Action
action.description: Dotted snake_case name of the action that was attempted, e.g. 'credential.request' (spec section 53). Follows the same dotted-path style as capability ids (spec section 28) but is not restricted to registered capabilities and may be a single segment.

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: Resource the action targeted, e.g. 'aws-dev' (spec section 53). Resource names only — never secret values, tokens, or file contents (spec section 53 never-log rule).

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Policy decision applied to the action: allow, deny, or approval_required (spec sections 20, 53).

policy_ids.title: Policy ids
policy_ids.description: Identifiers of the policies that produced the decision, e.g. ["eng-ai-v3"] (spec section 53).

result.title: Result
result.description: Outcome of the action after the decision was applied, e.g. 'success' (spec section 53). The spec does not enumerate result values; lowercase snake_case strings by convention.
